source_record.title: Give Up to Get More: Priors, Not Policies, Govern Test-Time Compute Allocation
source_record.problem: 预算分配器需要识别下一次尝试的收益；按困难程度单调增加样本会浪费预算，但可用先验的来源与成本也不能忽略。
source_record.insight: 固定独立尝试的边际覆盖收益随成功率呈非单调关系；有验证器时，历史成功率先验可将预算从无望输入转向尚可解决的输入。
source_record.method: Offline replays of stored math/code/proof responses; static equal-attempt allocation and sequential RR/TS/UCB/myopic policies, cross-fitted related-model histories. Fresh Qwen2.5 samples remain replayed, not a live adaptive-serving experiment.
source_record.result: At u=16, Table2 Pythia-1.4B MATH RR14.1% and history-TS +12.5 percentage points; Table11 uses independent100-replay set and reports +12.0 [11.5,12.5]. Do not combine their baselines/CIs.
source_record.limitation: Fixed recurring inputs, iid attempts, main perfect/free verifier and sunk history sampling. Output-character charging is not tokenized FLOPs/latency. Weak priors or false acceptances erase gains; easy cases can lose. Calibration/replay uncertainty does not establish deployment transfer or independent replication.
source_record.sections_read: Primary metadata/history; HTML §§1–6, Tables1–11, Appendix E.7–E.12; selected theory formulation in §2. Appendix C proofs, continuous-objective appendix and survey coding not fully audited. Public code README read; code not executed.
source_record.changes_existing_conclusion: Strengthens existing T5 marginal-value allocation discussion with empirical dependence on information quality, recurring-input history and verifier error; not a new universal scaling exponent.

recommended_body_additions.placement: T5 §6 after Zhai adaptive-budget paragraph and before closing synthesis paragraph
recommended_body_additions.proposal_en: The marginal-value view also raises an information question: how can an allocator identify inputs that will benefit? Bae studies recurring inputs using stored math, code and proof samples. For independent, fixed-cost attempts, the static optimum favors intermediate solvability rather than always giving the hardest inputs more. With a perfect, unpriced verifier that removes solved inputs, the baseline becomes round-robin over unsolved inputs. On Pythia-1.4B MATH, at an average budget of sixteen attempts, a cross-fitted prior from Pythia-6.9B raises the observed solved share from 14.1% to 26.6% under Thompson Sampling; without input-specific information, tested policies gain essentially nothing. This result assumes that the history sampling cost has already been paid. Fresh proxy sampling is charged and can lose its advantage. Evidence is mainly offline replay, including newly generated Qwen2.5 pools; replay intervals do not establish live-serving transfer. Weak priors and false acceptances erode gains, and easy workloads can lose without prior tempering. Output-length checks charge characters, not measured FLOPs or latency. Thus informative, affordable priors and reliable checking are conditions for allocation gains; the policy title does not make algorithm choice irrelevant.
recommended_body_additions.proposal_zh: 边际收益视角还提出一个信息问题：分配器如何识别哪些输入会受益？Bae 用保存的数学、代码和证明样本研究反复出现的输入。在尝试相互独立、单次成本固定时，静态最优分配偏向中等可解性，而非总给最难输入更多预算。在验证器被视为完美且不计费、并移除已解输入时，基线变成对未解输入轮询。Pythia-1.4B 的 MATH 实验中，平均预算为十六次尝试时，来自 Pythia-6.9B、经交叉拟合的先验使 Thompson Sampling 的观测解题比例从 14.1% 升至 26.6%；缺乏输入特定信息时，所测策略基本没有收益。该结果假定历史采样费用已经支付；新采集的小模型代理样本被计费后可能失去优势。证据主要来自离线回放，包括新生成的 Qwen2.5 样本池；回放区间不能确立在线服务迁移。弱先验与误接受会削弱收益，简单工作负载在不弱化先验时还可能受损。长度检查按字符计费，不是实测 FLOPs 或延迟。因此，有信息且成本可接受的先验与可靠检查是分配收益的条件；论文标题并不表示算法选择无关紧要。

source_record.title: Test-Time Compute Scales Better with Parallel Agent Teams
source_record.problem: 独立 agent 反复搜索可能饱和；扩大单一协作团队则降低跨次尝试的独立性与可选择性。
source_record.insight: 小团队内部共享发现，多个团队之间独立运行，再由任务评分器选择最高分结果，将单次质量与跨次变化分开。
source_record.method: Qwen3.8-27B in Codex harness,12 continuous-score tasks; best-of-pool estimates over roughly100solo and10–11team runs/task; normally12h/agent,6h on Browser Exploit.
source_record.result: At100agents,10teams of10 outrank solo sampling on10/12tasks; large-team comparison only4tasks. Scores are conditional retained-pool estimates, not broad deployment success guarantees.
source_record.limitation: Same agent-hours need not mean equal tokens/FLOPs; team agents use1.0–2.2× solo tokens. Large-team counts sparse; infra-killed and known kernel reward-exploit runs excluded. Gaussian fit misses ceilings/tails. Automatic scorer needed; author code link returned404; no independent replication identified.
source_record.sections_read: Primary metadata/history; HTML §§1–4,6–8 and Appendices B–F,J; selected Appendix A equations and Appendix I discussion; prompt blocks encountered but not executed or adopted as instructions. Figures not digitized; code unavailable through cited URL.
source_record.changes_existing_conclusion: Adds nested team sampling as a conditional coordination branch after PTTS, distinguishing stronger individual team draws from greater sampling count; not evidence every larger team or fixed team size is optimal.

recommended_body_additions.placement: T5 §1 after PTTS coordinated-coverage subsection, before §2
recommended_body_additions.proposal_en: Coordination can also change what counts as one sample. Wang et al. run small teams with a shared forum, keep different teams independent, and select the highest-scoring team. With Qwen3.8-27B and a budget of one hundred agents, ten teams of ten outperform independent agents on ten of twelve long-horizon tasks. Runs normally allow twelve hours per agent, with six hours for Browser Exploit. The intended mechanism is a stronger team-level draw while retaining variation across draws. The curves, however, are combinatorial estimates from retained pools, including only ten or eleven small-team runs per task; very large teams have still fewer repetitions. Infrastructure-killed runs and known kernel reward-exploit runs are excluded. Equal agent-hours do not imply equal tokens or FLOPs: team members consume 1.0–2.2 times the tokens of solo agents. A Gaussian score model explains the tradeoff qualitatively but misses failure tails and ceilings. This extends coordinated sampling under automatic scoring; it does not establish a universal team size, reliable selection without a verifier, or an externally replicated scaling law.
recommended_body_additions.proposal_zh: 协作还可以改变一次样本的单位。Wang 等让小团队通过共享论坛协作，使不同团队独立运行，再选择评分最高的团队结果。采用 Qwen3.8-27B、总预算为一百个 agent 时，十个十人团队在十二项长时域任务中的十项优于独立 agent。通常每个 agent 运行十二小时，Browser Exploit 为六小时。其机制是提高团队级单次结果的质量，同时保留跨团队变化。不过，这些曲线由保留的运行池作组合估计而得，每项任务只有十或十一个小团队运行；超大团队的重复次数更少。基础设施中止的运行及触发已知内核奖励漏洞的运行被排除。相同 agent 小时数不意味着相同 token 或 FLOPs：团队成员消耗的 token 是独立 agent 的 1.0–2.2 倍。高斯分数模型能定性解释权衡，却不能准确处理失败尾部与分数上限。这将协调采样扩展到自动评分环境，并未确立普适团队规模、无验证器的可靠选择或外部复现的缩放定律。
